grandparents_cupboard.reason: Fresh fruit, oats, flour, almonds, sugar, oil, lemon and cinnamon are all ordinary cupboard and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Peaches, raspberries and the cupboard items are everyday supermarket buys in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a mixing bowl and simple rubbing-in.

works.reason: Four peaches and 300g raspberries under an oat crumble at 190°C for 30 to 35 minutes gives a sensible fruit crumble for four.

honest_times.reason: Stoning peaches, zesting a lemon, chopping almonds and mixing the topping fits in 15 minutes, and the 35-minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Raspberries and peaches are at their best in late June, and a crumble that can be eaten warm or cold suits midsummer.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is mostly fruit with an oat and almond topping and modest sugar, a satisfying snack a family would make again.
